svg.title: Runner receipts and confirmed terminal states
svg.desc: Queued work can become cancelled directly. Running work usually enters cancelling until shutdown is confirmed. Unconfirmed ownership or cleanup yields unknown, not a promise that effects were undone. reconcileUnknown verifies resources on the original node and preserves the unknown business outcome.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["queued: accepted, not yet executing"] B["running: executing node owns the lease"] C["succeeded / failed: execution and cleanup confirmed"] D["cancelling: requested, awaiting shutdown"] E["cancelled: cancellation confirmed"] U["unknown: outcome or shutdown unconfirmed"] R["Reconcile on original node; release occupancy, keep outcome unknown"] A -->|"claimed"| B B -->|"execution and cleanup confirmed"| C A -->|"cancel while queued"| E B -->|"cancel request"| D D -->|"shutdown confirmed"| E B -->|"lost ownership / shutdown unconfirmed"| U D -->|"shutdown unconfirmed"| U U --> R classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class C,E good; class A,D,U,R pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
